description: Leverage Microsoft.CodeAnalysis Refactoring APIs to replace or enhance rt's custom extract-method, inline-method, and extract-class implementations. Reduces maintenance burden, improves code quality through proven Roslyn logic, and enables faster feature development (parameterization, etc).

epics.title: Leverage Roslyn Refactoring APIs
epics.description: Systematically audit rt's extract-method, inline-method, and extract-class commands against Roslyn's built-in Refactoring APIs. Replace or enhance custom implementations where Roslyn provides proven, battle-tested logic.
epics.notes: Blocked by: US-029 (semantic validation fix), US-032 (parameterization). High-value follow-ups: reduces parameterization dev time from 4-6h to 2-3h; unblocks future inline/extract-class quality improvements.

userStories.title: Audit Roslyn ExtractMethodService vs. rt's MethodExtractor
userStories.description: Analyze Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Refactoring.ExtractMethodService to understand its signature inference, parameter ordering, return type inference, and variable tracking logic. Document which responsibilities overlap with rt's custom MethodExtractor and identify leverage opportunities.
userStories.notes: Roslyn source: /src/LanguageServer/Protocol/Handler/Refactoring/ExtractMethodHandler.cs. Compare: parameter inference, return value tracking, variable scope analysis, naming conventions.

userStories.title: Audit Roslyn inline-method support vs. rt's InlineMethodService
userStories.description: Analyze Roslyn's inline refactoring capabilities (if any) or Roslyn.Services patterns for inlining. Document overlap with InlineMethodService (parameter substitution, return value capture, method removal).
userStories.notes: May find that Roslyn has less built-in support here; if so, document the gap and mark as lower-priority follow-up.

userStories.title: Audit Roslyn extract-class vs. rt's ExtractClassService and fix known gaps
userStories.description: Analyze Roslyn's class extraction support. Document overlap with rt's ExtractClassService. Identify why rt doesn't update external call sites and why generated code has indentation/access-modifier bugs. Decide: replace or enhance?
userStories.notes: Known gaps: US-030 (no external call-site updates, stripped indentation, wrong access modifiers). May be simpler to fix rt's gaps than replace entirely.

userStories.title: Implement extract-method wrapper around ExtractMethodService
userStories.description: Replace MethodExtractor.ExtractAsync core logic with a wrapper around Roslyn's ExtractMethodService. Layer rt-specific features on top: --replace-duplicates, semantic validation, parameterization hooks. Ensure extracted signatures match Roslyn's inference.
userStories.notes: After US-033 audit. Keep existing tests passing (655 tests). Prototype first; if Roslyn's signature inference diverges from rt's, defer to US-032/US-037.

userStories.title: Regression test extract-method against 67 duplicate groups
userStories.description: Run rt's extract-method (with new Roslyn-backed implementation) against all 67 identified duplicate groups. Verify extracted signatures are correct and semantically valid. Document any divergences from prior behavior.
userStories.notes: Depends on US-036. Use dogfood playbook (tasks/PLAYBOOK-duplicate-extraction.md). Can run in parallel with inline/extract-class audits.

userStories.title: Implement inline-method wrapper around Roslyn (if supported)
userStories.description: If Roslyn has inline support (US-034), implement wrapper. If not, document why and propose: (A) keep current InlineMethodService + enhance for correctness, (B) wait for future Roslyn version. Ensure parameter substitution and precedence parenthesization work correctly.
userStories.notes: Depends on US-034. Lower priority if Roslyn support is limited.

userStories.title: Fix extract-class gaps or implement Roslyn wrapper
userStories.description: Decide: (A) enhance rt's ExtractClassService to update external call sites, fix indentation/access-modifier bugs (US-030); (B) replace with Roslyn wrapper. Implement chosen path. Verify build is clean after extraction.
userStories.notes: Depends on US-035 audit. Known issues: call-site updates missing, indentation stripped, access modifiers wrong. May be pragmatic to fix (A) rather than replace (B).
